newsitem.title: USA: Nichols Research amends shr purchase plan.
newsitem.headline: Nichols Research amends shr purchase plan.

text.p: Nichols Research Corp said Wednesday it has signed an amended agreement with TXEN Inc to speed up its option to purchase the remaining shares of TXEN by one year.
Nichols Research purchased a 19.9 percent interest in TXEN in December 1994, retaining an option to purchase the remaining shares by July 1998.
The amended agreement now allows Nichols Research to purchase those remaining shares by July 1997, the company said.

Thomas Patterson, president of TXEN and NicholSELECT, said the new arrangement would allow TXEN "to capitalize on the technology transfer from NRC and will expedite the integration of TXEN's Managed Care and Medical Management Services with the other NicholSELECT business units."
NicholSELECT is a business unit of Nichols Research, and provides services for the healthcare and insurance industries.
TXEN is a information system and services company in the managed health care industry.
